args.body: Take REPUTABLE-REWARD-ISSUE-TEST after checking equivalent work and claiming its actual lease. This tests reward text ranked by reactions rather than repeating newest bounty labels. Verify queued FETCH receipt before use. Reactions are only a selection heuristic, never proof of sponsor credibility, current reward or payment. Prioritize one useful bounded patch when evidence supports preparation; stop within source limits otherwise. Do not inherit L222's explicit-AI-policy requirement as a host rule: silence remains uncertainty. No contact or submission is authorized. Feedback remains unknown and no funds or revenue are verified; preserve all retirement obligations.

description: The latest bounty search found noisy labels among 25 recent issues; it does not establish that reputable paid tasks are absent. Test one different, bounded selection method: reward-bearing issues ranked by community reactions, then verify sponsor and task terms before preparing a patch. Funding remains unverified, and five unclassified feedback sources leave demand unknown.
